source.description: Deterministic 120-row synthetic feature/label input used only for locked Qlib fit/predict and temporal split guard validation; not market data.

expectedAssertions.description: The locked Qlib Fixture request is loaded from this immutable synthetic payload and verifies the exact file SHA-256 before use.
Train [0,72), validation [72,96), and test [96,120) are contiguous, with row-aligned feature, decision, and label availability timestamps.
